description: Load the canonical DevSpec implementation contract pointer, assist Git commit provenance (ADR 71c23b46) without ever blocking edits or execution, report every commit this agent makes so work can be attributed to it, from git itself through a private stand-in for git that the environment file Claude Code applies to each of this conversation's shell commands puts first on PATH, with nothing installed in any repository, and tag or stop commits in the project's repositories inside that stand-in, from git's own arguments (items 27fab61a, 604c360a, e597bc18), mirror remote-control turns, and make the plugin's configured DevSpec key and server address reachable from the plugin's own commands (item bb97c9f6 - Claude Code gives userConfig to hooks but not to Bash tool calls) through a per-conversation file only the user can read, never the session environment, whose text Claude Code puts on every command line (item 4d40407b). Commit references are observed only on commit-message surfaces this can read with certainty; every uncertainty, missing runtime or hook failure allows the operation, and keep the listener Claude Code starts with the session attached to the right conversation across /clear and /resume (item b7ef1fe2). After a tool writes a .devspec/project.json folder pin, check it is one DevSpec can read, and after a pinned folder gets a repository DevSpec does not track, remind the person where to add it (item fa9b809b). When this conversation is attached to a DevSpec room, tell the model, as counts and never message bodies, when messages it has not read arrive while it works, and hold a room post once when something arrived it has not been told about (item 55feedd7). Tell DevSpec which model Claude Code is running, at what effort and how full its context is, from Claude Code's own figures at each turn's start and end (item 2382364d). When an error from Anthropic's service ends a turn before Claude can answer a room command, tell the room in Claude Code's own words and end the turn (item b6a38d81).
